Hi, Au,
Thanks for your information.
Below is the unit price we can do for you.
USD$140: 5-port managed
USD$195: 8-port managed
USD$170: 8-port unmanaged

For a bulk order, lets discuss.
Example: its 185usd for the sample unit(8-port managed), as I explained before, it is the bulk price.
Honestly we can do better based on the quantity(5-port managed and 8-port managed).
For 8-port unmanaged, it is not easy to give a discount(the profit is thin now), but it depends on cases.

Regarding the price comparison
1, shipping cost is not much from China to Singapore especially when the quantity is more.
The CIF price will be lower.
Example: the model you purchased is 1pc, 25usd shipping cost.
CIF price: 210usd/pc
I just checked, if you do 10pcs, shipping cost will be 80usd
CIF price: 193usd/pc
If you order more, product unit price will be lower, shipping cost will not increase too much, CIF price will be more competitive.
So it is just about more pieces, the average price(CIF price) will be better.

2, I think our price advantage is the 5-port and 8-port managed model.
As I said above, we can give a further discount if the quantity is good.
But for 8-port unmanaged, it seems not very competitive.
I compared the price SGD$270: TL-SX1008: 8-port unmanaged with 3 years warranty
Its about 207usd, compared with our offer 170usd+shipping cost, it is not competitive enough.
If this is a decent order of mixed models(managed and unmanaged), we will do our best to give a further discount(an extreme situation, we make the profit very very thin, we still have some profit from managed models), this is what I wrote above, it depends on cases.

3, In our daily work, some clients will also ask us below questions
How is your product better than some famous brands?
Why do I have to choose your products?
...
Honestly if it is not a bulk order, it is not easy to compete with some famous brands like TPlink or Planet.
They have better technical strength, they manufacture in batches each time(because clients around the world accept their brand, never worry about the selling issue).
For us, the R&D cost is usually higher and we mostly give the very best prices based on bulk orders(we need to think about selling and profit).
So this is very different.
However, we still have our own advantage.
1, as I explained, our prices are not higher than TPlink though some prices are not very competitive.
2, we support customization and do our best to support you(for some famous brands, customization is not very easy)

With all that said, I think you should understand this situation.
We have pros and cons compared with some famous brands, it depends on your business plan.
If you decide to promote your own brand, maybe it is an option to customize something, we can do this for you easily.
If it is just about selling something locally, just push for better prices.
Either way, I think you could work out something based on our offer, and we will do our best to support you, every question every detail...

Hopefully this lengthy explanation will be useful to enhance your understanding our business ideas/positioning.
Please let me know your feedback.
Thank you.

The OLSON TECHNOLOGY Optical Transmitters (OTOT) and Premise Nodes (OTPN) are designed with the very latest optical transmitter and receiver technology to reliably deliver a full slate of multiplexed video, high speed data & telephony services in an HFC\DOCSIS fiber-to-the-premise (FTTP) environment. 

 

The OTOT unit is ideally suited for direct fiber transmission of CATV-DOCSIS RF over Fiber signals for FTTH, MDU applications where  a high performance, compact indoor transmitter is required.  The Optical Transmitter (OTOT-1200) comes with in either 1310nm or1550nm transmits wavelengths and is available in either 3, 6, 9, 12 or 15dBm output power accommodating most typical link budgets.

 

The OTPN-2200 MiniNode is equipped with a highly sensitive optical receiver permitting links deeper into the subscriber base. The OTPN-2200C accepts a return path transmitter for two-way CATV\Broadband service and can be equipped with a PON Bypass for XGS PON subscribers.  This combination is perfectly suited for MDU application where operators can offer "Basic TV" to all, but also offer OTT IPTV or Netflix\Hulu\Prime to PON subscribers.

subj: Re: Confidential :: Angora Networks new brand TronX
text:
Hello Simon;
Regarding your technical questions, here are the specifics for the new
TronX brand.

Currently, the TronX catalog includes three products:

* 24 Port L2+ POE+ with 10G uplinks
* 48 Port L2+ POE+ with 10G uplinks
* 48x25G Data Center switches with 100G uplinks

We will handle the data center switches independently using our existing
model, so we can discuss this product later.

For the 24 and 48-port switches, your current hardware is sufficient, and
no software development is needed.

The primary requirement is to rebrand the serial numbers and product names:

* 24 Port = TRX-AS-24TP4X
* 48 Port = TRX-AS-48TP4X

The serial number conventions are as follows:

* 24 Port = TRX2404PA25xxxxx
* 48 Port = TRX4804PA25xxxxx

The last five digits (xxxxx) will represent the unique device number.

Since TronX does not yet have its own MAC address block, you can use any
address from your current address space. We can update this should they
decide to acquire their own MAC OUI in the future.

I've attached the TRONX logo. For the device branding, adding the logo to
the front panel and the top of the devices (if feasible) will be ok; a
fancy front panel is not necessary.

Please let me know if you require any additional information.

Thanks,
Taylan

STC-424DGGPM-280W	TRX-AS-24TP4X	24 Port PoE+
STC-448XGGPM	TRX-AS-48TP4X	48 Port PoE+

subj: Re: Software renaming for Turk Telekom tests
text:
Hello Simon,

Let me give some more details.
This is a revised expansion of the old Turk Telekom project where we need
functions like ACL, SFLOW, HTTPS and SFTP.
Before it was a switch only project, now we change the game and add a
management system and smart site functionality such as reading temperature,
humidity, door statuses, camera video delivery and so on. We ll also ise
the IO relay on the switch to trigger a door opening scenario.

The request would be 8 port PoE industrials with SFP ports, probably 2.5G

There are around 10.000 site to be implemented. Initial phase would consist
of a pilot with around 500-1000 devices

We are working to develop other parts and we are ready on our side. We are
investing lots of resources to make this project happen. I will share a
link with you later today, for you to check our platform

The tests on friday would be on 2 site. Since we already have 16 ports, we
decide to use them here.

So appreciate if we can rename the software. Also if we can add sftp that
would be much better, but it is not a must for the tests.

Please let me know if you need more details

Thanks in advance

Taylan

Please be aware that my fingers are not designed and evolved for smartphone
messaging 😉
